title: Aimei Health Technology Co., Ltd. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: This is a routine SEC Form 8-K filing for Aimei Health Technology Co., Ltd., a SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Company), disclosing the 17th extension of its termination date to May 6, 2026 and the issuance of an unsecured promissory note for $34,330.96 to fund the extension payment. The company is attempting to complete a business combination with United Hydrogen Group Inc.
key_points: Aimei Health Technology Co., Ltd. is a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq under ticker AFJK
The company extended its termination date from April 6, 2026 to May 6, 2026—the 17th such extension under its charter
An Extension Payment of $34,330.96 was deposited into the trust account, representing the lesser of $80,000 total or $0.033 per outstanding public share per monthly extension
The company issued an unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note for $34,330.96 to Sponsor (Aimei Health Ltd) and United Hydrogen Group Inc., each receiving $17,165.48
The Promissory Note becomes due upon consummation of the Business Combination and may be converted into private units at $10.00 per unit
The Business Combination target is United Hydrogen Group Inc.
